title: 그런데
part: Relaciones lógicas y modalidad básica — 논리 관계와 기본 양태
articleMarkdown:
#### En pocas palabras

The NIKL Korean Basic Dictionary documents **그런데** in discourse as a connector that can signal a change of direction or contrast; its examples include contrastive and topic-shift contexts. The exact Spanish equivalent depends on the context, so this entry avoids fixed translation equivalence.

#### Fuentes y localizadores

National Institute of Korean Language. (s. f.). 그런데. In *Korean Basic Dictionary*. National Institute of Korean Language. https://krdict.korean.go.kr/eng/dicSearch/SearchView?ParaWordNo=70717&nation=eng

Korean Basic Dictionary, entry 그런데, senses 1–3 and example sentences: change of direction, contrast, and discourse-opening use.

#### Entradas relacionadas

Se relaciona con **하지만** y **-지만**, que también expresan contraste, y se distingue de **그래서**, cuyo valor básico es presentar una consecuencia o resultado. También comparte ciertos usos discursivos con construcciones en **-는데 / -(으)ㄴ데**.
